test.author: Christoph Deppisch
test.name: CreateVariablesIT
test.description:
It might be helpful to reset existing variables during the testworkflow as well as to define new variables during a test.
To archieve that, you can easily use the service bean 'settingVariables'. This bean offers a map 'variables' to declare new variables or overwrite existing variable values using the well known key-value syntax of the entry element.
New variables can be defined by simply declaring a new variable name. These variables are valid for the rest of the testworkflow. Existing variable values will be exchanged with the new value given.
